notes.title: Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1-2 Remastered is Available for Pre-Order!
notes.content:
[h3]Celebrate Soul Reaver’s 25th Anniversary -- pre-order Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1-2 Remastered today![/h3]

Experience the epic conflict of Kain and Raziel in original form or with remastered graphics.

[b]Included Game Titles
[/b]Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2

[b]Experience the Legendary Narrative
[/b]Centuries after your former master, Kain, betrays and executes you, you rise again and embark on a relentless quest for revenge. 

[b]Wield the Powers of a Wraith
[/b]Slay your former vampire brethren with your claws, bolts of telekinetic energy, and the elemental Wraith Blade. Grow stronger by devouring the souls of your enemies.

[b]Shift Between Realms
[/b]The Elder God has granted you the ability to shift between the Spectral and Material Realms. Traverse the realms to solve puzzles, reveal new paths, and defeat your foes.
